stage1.impression: A flat, cropped dark-brown panel fills the top 57% of the frame and reads as a wall, not as a record sleeve. The stand below reads as mirror chrome, with a hard white band, a hard black band and orange edge glints, and the fan-shaped insert reads as an evenly pale, ruled card rather than a mirror.

blocking_9: The whole object is in the frame: the sleeve's top edge sits below the frame's top with cove above it (top-centre band [700,0,1100,30] lum_median > 140; now 67).

The set sits near its specified value, not blown out: the floor and cove are at lum 175-205, not 221-226, so the clear acrylic's edges and silhouette separate from the ground. Now the left end face [345,870,410,1000] is 206 against a floor of 226.
The shard reads as a mirror: one graded edge of reflected light across it, from hot (>225) to dark (<110). Now it is a flat 219-226 across its width, with a range of 41 inside it.
The shard shows a specular streak along its grooves (a small clipped highlight, 0.2-3% of the shard). Now nothing clips (p95 233).
The sleeve reads black with a sheen (median 25-50), not as warm brown board (now 67, r72 g66 b60).
The block casts a visible contact shadow: the floor beside its foot is >= 25 levels darker than the open floor. Now [1440,900,1700,1000] is 226 with a range of 5.
No moire in the groove field: the arcs of beating lines across the centre of the shard (crop 760-1110 x 720-960) are gone, from a groove pitch resolved at frame scale or from a detail frame.

changes.problem: The camera crops the sleeve at the top, so a featureless brown plane fills x 330-1385, y 0-680 and the object never reads as a record in a stand.

evidence.measured: lum_median 66.8, range 25.5, profile 69.6 to 57.6 top to bottom; the top-centre band [700,0,1100,30] is sleeve at about 67, with no cove above it

changes.expected: The view widens about 1.33x, so the block spans about 45-50% of the frame width and the sleeve's full height fits once c2 raises the target.

changes.problem: The target at z 95 centres the frame low, so after widening the sleeve's top would still be cut off while empty floor fills the bottom.

evidence.measured: floor lum_median 226 fills the bottom 150 px; the sleeve runs off the top edge

changes.expected: The visible z range runs from about -60 to 380 mm: the block's foot sits about 150 px above the bottom edge and the sleeve's top edge about 60-100 px below the top edge, with cove above it.

changes.problem: The overhead blows the set out to near white, far above the specified #A9A7A3 (luma about 167), so the clear acrylic's end faces vanish into the ground and the block has no contact shadow.

evidence.measured: floor median 226 (range 18), left cove [20,100,300,550] 221, right of the foot [1440,900,1700,1000] 226 with a range of 5; the acrylic's left end [345,870,410,1000] is 206, a step of only 20

changes.expected: The floor and cove drop to about 180-200, the key's shadow becomes visible beside the block, and the acrylic's silhouette steps 30+ levels from the ground. The sleeve darkens toward 40-50.

changes.problem: The 160 mm front strip fills the shard's whole reflection, so the mirror reads as a flat, pale, matte card with no reflected edge.

evidence.measured: shard interior lum_median 222.6, p5 192.8, p95 233.4, range 40.6; x profile 219.6 to 225.7, flat

changes.expected: The strip's lower edge crosses the shard's reflection: the upper part of the shard stays hot (>225) and the lower part falls to the darker cove (<110) with a soft graded edge, so the shard reads as a polished mirror.

changes.problem: The glint spot leaves no anisotropic streak on the shard: nothing clips, so the grooves never flash.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 0.0, p95 233.1 over the whole shard

changes.expected: A narrow streak, stretched along the grooves and a few px wide, reaches 250+ on a small part of the shard without bleaching it.

changes.problem: The acrylic's end faces and lower edge show no dark line to define the block, so the block reads as chrome bands, not as a clear solid.

evidence.measured: the left end face has median 206, p5 192, beside a floor of 226; the white band [420,820,1340,900] is 230 and joins the floor's value

change.to: two matte black cards, 150 x 450 mm, standing vertically just outside frame at x = -330 and x = +330, y = -80, base z = 0, faces turned 30 degrees toward the block's end faces

changes.expected: Each end face of the acrylic picks up a dark refracted line (<90) about 10-20 px wide along its vertical edges, defining the block's silhouette against the light floor.

changes.problem: Even once dimmed, the warm cove (#A9A7A3) feeds the sleeve a warm bounce that makes a black sleeve read as brown board.

evidence.measured: sleeve r72 g66 b60, median 66.8; the cove reads r187 g182 b175

changes.expected: The sleeve goes toward neutral black, with r-b < 8 and a median of 25-50 together with c3.

out_of_scope.request: Make the groove pitch coarser, or change the shard's geometry, to remove the moire arcs across its centre.
out_of_scope.why: The shard's geometry is fixed. At a smaller scale after c1 the moire may grow; a detail frame, or render-side supersampling, is the route, and it decides whether the shard reads as grooves or as a pattern.

out_of_scope.request: Hide the stray plates and sleeve edge visible behind the block's left end (x 330-410, y 680-870).
out_of_scope.why: They are the object's own geometry seen through the acrylic; only the camera angle can change them, and c1/c2 reframe it.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the orange glints at the slot and along the base stratum.
out_of_scope.why: They come from the fixed acrylic optics and tint stratum under caustics. Light placement can move them but should not erase them.
